description: This Kotlin source file defines the PlaybackServiceConnector class, which abstracts the binding to a playback service in an Android application and provides a set of public API methods for UI layers to control audio playback, load decks, adjust settings, and manage mix sharing.

classes.name: PlaybackServiceConnector
classes.description: A class that manages connection to a PlaybackService, allowing binding/unbinding and providing control methods for audio playback and settings adjustments.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Starts and binds to the PlaybackService.

methods.name: unbind
methods.description: Unbinds and releases the service connection if currently bound.

methods.name: loadDeckA
methods.description: Instructs the service to load deck A with the given URI.

methods.name: loadDeckB
methods.description: Instructs the service to load deck B with the given URI.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Commands the service to start playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Commands the service to pause playback.

methods.name: setCrossfade
methods.description: Sets the crossfade value in the service.

methods.name: saveCurrentMix
methods.description: Saves the current mix state asynchronously and invokes the callback with success status.

methods.name: shareCurrentMix
methods.description: Shares the latest saved mix via the repository.
